reason: My register has never failed me and I know every bill in it. The money isn't the problem, but on a busy Saturday my stylists won't stop between clients to take a selfie and type numbers into a phone, and I'm not risking upsetting the good staff I still have.
objection: My staff are busy with customers. They won't type everything into an app, so in two weeks I'll be back to the register and paying ₹999 a month for nothing.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it running at another salon owner's outlet I know, with the stylists actually using it on a busy day, plus a free month where my front desk does all the entries instead of the stylists.
